content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT (BHU) Project Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (Banaras Hindu University) Varanasi, commonly known as IIT (BHU), for an ICMR sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post under this recruitment notification is Project Associate, aimed at research-based activities in the specified engineering and technology branches.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for IIT (BHU) Project Associate?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech degree in CSE, IT, AI, ECE, or allied branches, along with qualification in GATE or an equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years. Age relaxations are provided as per rules for reserved categories and female candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of 28,000 per month along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) @20%.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications via email is 14-10-2026. Candidates must ensure submissions reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates need to compile their application and documents into a single PDF file and send it.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application PDF be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be emailed to the Principal Investigator (PI), Prof. S.K. Singh at [email protected] with the appropriate subject line.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates and document verification.
